title: Holomorphic disk extension of a bounded periodic function
statement: Let w>0 be real and g:ℂ→ℂ. Suppose g is holomorphic on H={z:Im z>0}, g(z+w)=g(z) for every z∈H, and there exist C,Y∈ℝ such that ‖g(z)‖≤C whenever z∈H and Y≤Im z. Then there exists A:ℂ→ℂ holomorphic on D={q:‖q‖<1} such that g(z)=A(exp(2πiz/w)) for every z∈H.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → g (z + (w : ℂ)) = g z) → (∃ C Y : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y ≤ z.im → ‖g z‖ ≤ C) → ∃ A : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → g z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z / (w : ℂ))))
